clauses.clause_label: Restrictions on package and derivative works
clauses.scope_note: Applies to redistribution, modification, sublicensing, and commercial use of this package or any derivative work; those activities are not permitted when there is no written agreement with eximagent.ai.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction applies absent a written agreement with eximagent.ai. The text does not specify the agreement’s terms or scope.

coverage_notes: The supplied text identifies the package as a thin client for the eximagent.ai backend and says its source is not public, but gives no separate operative grant for use, copying, integration, network access, or source provision. No permission is inferred from the description of the package as being provided for convenience.
The SPDX identifier names a proprietary license reference but supplies no additional terms; no external or omitted conditions are reconstructed.
